text:
- **Faster pull request checks:** Each pull request runs only the Go tests its changes can affect. Median run time still misses its target, because macOS runners are limited by core count.
- **Owner questions and requests:** Agent questions accept an answer on the site or in chat, and the first answer counts. Owner replies reach sessions by push alone; agents no longer ask permission to open owner-requested work.
- **Agent guidance and sprint tooling:** AGENTS.md is now a short map that Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build read in full. Every pull request grades it against a rubric in CI, signed in without a stored API key.
- **Code layout and benchmark groundwork:** The command-line code is split by noun, and old code from the Python port is removed. A survey of long-horizon agent benchmarks now gives a shortlist for the new project on public benchmarks.
